summary: Bonner County, Idaho, lookout built around 1937 as a 40-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab and destroyed in 1955; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the peak

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as a hike-in

events.note: Around 1937 as a 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab (Forest Lookouts gives c.1937)

notes_for_editor: Thin record. All three guides give c.1937 and 1955; the Forest Lookouts page credits its dates to Kresek and the other two appear to repeat them. Record access 'unknown' left as is: no source describes access, so no facts.access was added. No source names anyone who staffed it (Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history), so staffing is omitted from the story. Record height 12.2 m matches the 40-foot pole. No photo found; no source describes the site today.
